replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Magic-link token generation is in design; weak token brute-force is concrete attack on sign-in."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Design includes invoice listing and card update; IDOR across customers is concrete and distinct."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Public sign-in page emailing links supports email flooding/reputation DoS attack."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"7-day validity quoted; replay of emailed link by inbox observer is concrete."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Credential-in-URL leakage via history/logs/referrer is distinct vector from T4 inbox access."},{"id":"T6","keep":false,"reason":"Same attack and harm as T4: link holder replays and changes card on file.","duplicateOf":"T4"},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Public email-only sign-in supports account enumeration; distinct harm of customer-list disclosure."}]}
